values.note: All 49 listed sites are back-ins with 50-ft driveways and a 40-ft max vehicle length; one RV or travel trailer per site. The park page says 50 sites.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Vista Point offers 50 campsites for group RV camping. facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping (Vista Point: 'Showers, restrooms, trash containers, and a dump station are conveniently located'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The park's camping page says these sites are open year-round with site water off in winter; its operating schedule lists the RV group camp March 1 to November 29, 2027 (March 27 to November 30 in 2026).

season.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area (Operating Season Schedule 2027, Vista Point Access: 'RV group camp March 1, 2027 Nov. 29, 2027'; 2026: 'March 27, 2026 Nov. 30, 2026') + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Although these sites are open year-round, water to the sites is turned off in the winter'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: ReserveAmerica: 'All of Vista Point RV campsites are walk-in only and cannot be reserved online or through the call center', and every date tried shows 'Not available online'. booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=3078&parkId=552903 (park notes: 'All of Vista Point RV campsites are walk-in only and cannot be reserved online or through the call center'; price breakdown for 2026-10-27, 2026-11-03, 2026-11-10, 2027-03-30, 2027-04-13 and 2027-04-17: 'No pricing information available', 'Not available online') + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping (Group RV Camping; 'Cancellation Policy for Group Campsites'), read 2026-10-22

note: Two rows of RV sites in the woods at the end of North Pea Ridge Road, back from the lake, near the Vista Point boat ramp, sailboat launch and swim beach. NC Parks lists it as group RV camping under its group cancellation policy, while ReserveAmerica lists the sites singly as walk-up only. --Claude
summary: Added 30-amp electric and water with no sewer, 49 back-in sites (40-ft max vehicle), showers and dump station, a March-November season (camping page says year-round), and walk-up-only booking per ReserveAmerica (reservable false, fcfs always). Fees left inherited: no price is shown for these sites. Note corrected: ReserveAmerica lists the sites but does not sell them.
flags: Booking conflict between official pages: ReserveAmerica says 'All of Vista Point RV campsites are walk-in only and cannot be reserved online or through the call center' and shows no price on any date; ncparks.gov lists Vista Point as 'group RV camping' with the group cancellation policy and a Book now link. Recorded walk-up (fcfs always). My split note's claim that ReserveAmerica 'sells the sites one at a time' was wrong and is corrected in the note.

Fees unknown: no ReserveAmerica price for any Vista Point site, and the rates page has no Vista-specific line (RV electric/water $40; improved group sites from $75, with the senior discount barred on group sites). Fees left inherited from the state row.
Season conflict: camping page 'open year-round' vs operating schedule 'RV group camp March 1 - November 29, 2027'. Recorded the schedule dates and quoted both in season.note.
ReserveAmerica's 'Distance to Body of Water' reads 100 ft for every Vista Point site, which the imagery does not bear out; waterfront left as not waterfront.
